newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends weaker v basket, firmer v dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends weaker v basket, firmer v dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed weaker against the central bank's currency basket on Friday following strong buying interest from one commercial bank.

The Hungarian currency finished trade at 196.00/05 to one dollar, around 20 pips weaker than the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level (bid) but slightly firmer against its opening level against the dollar of 196.15/20.

"It was quite a hectic day with strong (forex) buying interest from one commercial bank moving the forint from the bid," said Noemi Koppendorfer of ABN-AMRO Magyar Bank, adding that there didn't seem to be any external factor behind the move.
"I don't who it was but it wasn't us," she said.
Dealers expect the weakening to be only temporary and see the forint returning on Monday to its accustomed position against the resistance level.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
